skill.summary: Generates infographic image card series with 12 visual styles, 8 layouts, and 3 color palettes. Breaks content into 1-10 cartoon-style image cards optimized...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Improved user input handling: now prefers built-in agent tools for prompting users, with a fallback to numbered plain text if needed.
- Image backend selection logic clarified and made explicit, including override, preference, and auto-select order.
- Added requirement to emit the final image prompt file before invoking any backend.
- Confirmation policy updated: always confirm before generation unless explicitly told not to; now lists clear skip rules.
- Added references to new confirmation logic and updated workflow instructions.
- Minor documentation improvements and more precise descriptions throughout.
